
##  Genomic Overview

### Assembly analysis

&emsp;&emsp;Genome assembly was performed using Flye software (https://github.com/fenderglass/Flye, version: 2.9-b1768) to obtain initial assembly results that reflect the basic characteristics of the sample genome. Subsequently, the Racon software (version: 1.4.13) was used to correct the assembly results through three rounds of polishing based on third-generation sequencing data. This was followed by another three rounds of correction using Illumina reads with Pilon software (version: 1.22) to generate the final assembly results. The assembly statistics are shown in the table below:




<p class='mark'>Table 2-3: Statistics of Sample Genome Assembly Results</p>

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(DT)
data <- read.delim('file/02.Assembly/all.assembly.stat.xls',sep='\t',header=T)
datatable(data,rownames=FALSE,extensions=c('KeyTable','Buttons','FixedColumns'),options=list(keys=T,scrollX=T,dom = 'Bfrtip',buttons = list('copy', 'print', list(extend = 'collection',buttons = c('csv', 'excel', 'pdf'),text = 'Download')),initComplete = JS("function(settings, json) {","$(this.api().table().header()).css({'background-color':'#4682B4','color': 'white'});","}")),class='nowrap')
```


- **Sample ID**：Sample name
- **Contigs**：Number of contigs obtained from assembly
- **Max Contig Length**：Length of the largest contig in the assembled sequences
- **N50 Contig Length**：Length of the contig at which the cumulative length reaches 50% of the total length when assembled sequences are sorted in descending order
- **Totle Length**：The total length of all assembled contigs.
- **GC(%)**：The GC content of the assembled contigs.

###  Evaluation of the assembly result.

&emsp;&emsp;Reads were mapped to the assembled genome sequences. The GC bias and repetitive sequence characteristics of the genome were summarized by analyzing the GC content of the assembled sequences and the read coverage depth. The analysis results are shown in the following figure:


```{r echo=FALSE}
library(stringr)
library(bsselectR)
state_plots <- paste0(list.files("file/02.Assembly/","*GC_depth.png",full.names=TRUE))
names(state_plots) <- str_replace_all(state_plots,c("\\.GC_depth.png"="","file/02.Assembly//"=""))
bsselect(state_plots,type="img",height='40%',width='60%',live_search=TRUE,show_tick=TRUE,style='btn-info')
```

&emsp;&emsp;The BUSCO (Benchmarking Universal Single-Copy Orthologs: http://busco.ezlab.org/) assessment uses a library of single-copy orthologous genes and employs software such as meta euk and hmmer to evaluate the assembled genome, thereby assessing the completeness of the assembled genome.



<p class='mark'>Figure 2-4: BUSCO statistical table.</p>

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(DT)
data <- read.delim('file/02.Assembly/BUSCO.stat.xls',sep='\t',header=T)
datatable(data,rownames=FALSE,extensions=c('KeyTable','Buttons','FixedColumns'),options=list(keys=T,scrollX=T,dom = 'Bfrtip',buttons = list('copy', 'print', list(extend = 'collection',buttons = c('csv', 'excel', 'pdf'),text = 'Download')),initComplete = JS("function(settings, json) {","$(this.api().table().header()).css({'background-color':'#4682B4','color': 'white'});","}")),class='nowrap')
```

- **Sample ID**：Sample name
- **C**：Complete BUSCOs
- **S**：Complete and single-copy BUSCOs
- **D**：Complete Duplicated BUSCOs
- **F**：Fragmented BUSCOs
- **M**：Missing BUSCOs
- **n**：Total BUSCO groups searched

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(stringr)
library(bsselectR)
state_plots <- paste0(list.files("file/02.Assembly/","*.busco_figure.png",full.names=TRUE))
names(state_plots) <- str_replace_all(state_plots,c("\\.busco_figure.png"="","file/04.Genome_Function//"=""))
bsselect(state_plots,type="img",height='40%',width='60%',live_search=TRUE,show_tick=TRUE,style='btn-info')
```
<p class='mark'>Figure 2-3: BUSCO statistical graph.</p>
